privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.html:
Agimon Privacy Policy

Effective July 25, 2026

Agimon provides messaging workspaces that help organizations receive, organize, and respond to conversations from services they connect, including Instagram.

Information we process

  • Messages, replies, reactions, attachments, and related conversation content.
  • Instagram-scoped account and sender identifiers, usernames, timestamps, delivery information, and other message metadata supplied by Meta.
  • Connection credentials and configuration needed to operate an authorized integration.
  • Security, reliability, and audit logs associated with the workspace.

How we use information

We use this information to deliver conversations to the connected workspace, let authorized workspace members review and respond to them, operate configured automations, prevent duplicate delivery, troubleshoot failures, and protect the service.

Messaging infrastructure

When an organization enables a channel, conversation content may be relayed to and retained in the Telegram workspace selected by that organization. Meta and Instagram continue to process information under their own terms and policies.

Sharing

We do not sell personal information. We disclose information only to the organization operating the connected workspace, infrastructure providers needed to run Agimon, Meta or Instagram when required to operate the integration, and authorities when legally required.

Retention and security

Information is retained only as long as needed to operate the connected workspace, preserve its requested audit history, meet legal obligations, and maintain limited backups. We use access controls, encrypted network connections, restricted credential storage, and provider signature verification to protect integrations.

Your choices and deletion

You can stop future Instagram access by removing Agimon from Instagram's Apps and Websites settings. To request deletion of information held by Agimon, follow our data deletion instructions.

Contact

Questions or privacy requests may be sent to andres@agimon.io.

deletion.title: Data deletion
deletion.html:
Agimon Data Deletion Instructions

Disconnect Instagram

To stop future access immediately, sign in to the connected Instagram account, open Settings, then Apps and Websites, and remove Agimon.

Request deletion from Agimon

  1. Email andres@agimon.io with the subject “Agimon data deletion request.”
  2. Include the connected Instagram username and the Agimon workspace name. Do not include passwords or access tokens.
  3. We will verify that the requester controls the account or workspace, remove information that Agimon is required to delete, and confirm when the request is complete.

Some limited records may be retained when required for security, fraud prevention, legal compliance, or backup integrity, and will be removed when those obligations expire.
